CapabilitiesSummary.zh: 图片输入：{0} · 思考档位：{1}

LongSuggestions.en: Long names are omitted from inline suggestions. Select them from the fetched model list, or type the complete name.
LongSuggestions.zh: 过长名称不在输入框下展开；可返回已获取的模型列表选择，或手填完整名称。

ToolsSummary.zh: 服务端搜索：{0} · 图片生成：{1}

PageHelp.en: Arrows: move | Enter: select | Esc: back | Ctrl+C: exit
PageHelp.zh: 方向键移动 | 回车选择 | Esc 返回 | Ctrl+C 退出

SmallTerminal.en: Setup needs a terminal of at least 40 columns and 14 rows. Enlarge the terminal and run again.
SmallTerminal.zh: 配置向导需要至少 40 列、14 行的终端。请扩大窗口后重新运行。

PendingModels.en: Fetching models… Only this explicitly selected request will be sent. Cancellation keys are handled after it finishes; it will not be retried automatically.
PendingModels.zh: 正在获取模型列表……仅执行本次明确选择的请求。取消按键会在请求结束后处理，不会自动重试。

PendingTest.en: Testing the connection… This request may incur a charge. Cancellation keys are handled after it finishes; it will not be retried automatically.
PendingTest.zh: 正在测试连接……本次请求可能产生费用。取消按键会在请求结束后处理，不会自动重试。

UncertainCapabilities.en: Some capabilities are unknown or need confirmation. See details for sources and caveats.
UncertainCapabilities.zh: 部分能力尚不明确或需要确认，可在详情中查看来源与说明。

ShowDetails.zh: 查看完整配置及资料来源

Welcome.en: Set up a model before opening Lattice. Esc goes back; Ctrl+C exits. Language / 语言 is available in setup and review.
Welcome.zh: 先配置模型，再进入 Lattice。Esc 返回，Ctrl+C 退出；可在配置首页和总览切换 Language / 语言。

NoCatalog.en: The model catalog has no location. Set HOME or LATTICE_MODELS and try again.
NoCatalog.zh: 模型目录未启用或没有位置。请设置 HOME 或 LATTICE_MODELS 后重试。

Exited.en: Setup exited. Any configuration already saved remains available.
Exited.zh: 已退出配置。先前保存的配置仍然保留。

Failure.en: Setup could not continue. Original diagnostic: {0}
Failure.zh: 配置无法继续。原始诊断：{0}

LanguageChoice.en: Choose the setup language / 选择配置界面语言
LanguageChoice.zh: 选择配置界面语言 / Choose the setup language

LanguageSaved.en: Setup language saved. The current draft is unchanged.
LanguageSaved.zh: 已记住配置界面语言，当前草稿不变。

LanguageNotSaved.en: Language changed for this run, but could not be saved. Original diagnostic: {0}
LanguageNotSaved.zh: 本次已切换语言，但未能保存。原始诊断：{0}

SelectHelp.en: Type to filter | arrows: move | Enter: select | Esc: back | Ctrl+C: exit
SelectHelp.zh: 输入可筛选 | 方向键移动 | 回车选择 | Esc 返回 | Ctrl+C 退出

MultiHelp.en: Space: toggle | Enter: confirm | Esc: back | Ctrl+C: exit
MultiHelp.zh: 空格勾选 | 回车确认 | Esc 返回 | Ctrl+C 退出

InputHelp.en: Tab: complete | Enter: continue | Esc: back | Ctrl+C: exit
InputHelp.zh: Tab 补全 | 回车继续 | Esc 返回 | Ctrl+C 退出

SecretHelp.en: Key stays masked | Enter: continue | Esc: back | Ctrl+C: exit
SecretHelp.zh: 密钥不会明文显示 | 回车继续 | Esc 返回 | Ctrl+C 退出

ConfirmHelp.en: y: yes | n: no | Enter: default | Esc: back | Ctrl+C: exit
ConfirmHelp.zh: y 是 | n 否 | 回车采用默认值 | Esc 返回 | Ctrl+C 退出

Home.en: Choose how to configure the model

UnsafeCatalog.en: The catalog cannot be edited safely.
UnsafeCatalog.zh: 无法安全编辑模型目录。

LaunchOverride.en: Launch environment settings override saved preferences on future launches. This selection applies to this launch.
LaunchOverride.zh: 启动环境变量在以后启动时仍优先于保存的偏好，本次选择用于本次启动。

CredentialMenu.en: How should Lattice obtain the key?

KeyWarning.en: A local key is saved in an agent-readable file. File-tool reads can place it in permanent history and model context.
KeyWarning.zh: 本机密钥会保存在 agent 可读取的文件中。文件工具读取后，密钥可能进入永久流水及模型上下文。

HttpWarning.en: Warning: HTTP sends the credential without transport encryption.
HttpWarning.zh: 注意：HTTP 会以未加密的方式传输密钥。

BadUrl.en: Use an absolute HTTP(S) base URL without credentials, query or fragment.
BadUrl.zh: 请输入完整 HTTP(S) 基础地址，不要包含用户名、密码、查询参数或片段。

BadModel.en: Enter a nonempty model identifier without control characters (at most 1024 bytes).
BadModel.zh: 模型名称不能为空，不能含控制字符，长度不超过 1024 字节。

BadName.en: Use lower-case letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
BadName.zh: 本地名称使用小写英文字母、数字、点、下划线或短横线，以字母或数字开头。

DuplicateName.en: That local name already exists. Choose another name or use its repair option.
DuplicateName.zh: 该本地名称已存在。请选择其他名称，或使用已有条目的修复入口。

BadKey.en: Enter a nonempty key without control characters, not a redaction placeholder.
BadKey.zh: 请输入非空密钥，不能含控制字符，也不能是 [redacted] 占位符。

BadEnv.en: Choose an existing variable with a nonempty value and a valid variable name.
BadEnv.zh: 请输入已存在、值非空的有效环境变量名。

BadTokens.en: Enter a positive whole token count, e.g. 1000000, 1000k or 1M. Fractional tokens and overflow are rejected.
BadTokens.zh: 请输入正整数 token 数，例如 1000000、1000k 或 1M。不接受小数个 token 或溢出的数值。

BadUsage.en: Input/output mappings must not be empty; control characters are not allowed.
BadUsage.zh: 输入、输出用量字段不能为空；所有字段路径均不能包含控制字符。

BadEffort.en: Use distinct provider effort names, separated by commas.
BadEffort.zh: 请用英文逗号分隔不重复的提供方档位名称，仅限英文字母、数字、下划线和短横线。

FetchModels.en: Fetch model list from this service
FetchModels.zh: 从该服务获取模型列表

DiscoveryNotice.en: Fetch sends the entered credential to GET {0}. It sends no generation request. A model listing does not prove format or tool compatibility.
DiscoveryNotice.zh: 选择获取后，将携带已填写的密钥向 {0} 发出 GET 请求，不生成内容。出现在列表中不代表所有接口或工具均兼容。

DiscoveryFailed.en: Could not fetch models. Retry explicitly or enter a model manually. Original diagnostic: {0}
DiscoveryFailed.zh: 获取模型列表失败。可主动重试或手动填写。原始诊断：{0}

EmptyModels.en: No models are available in the fetched list. Enter a model manually or fetch again.
EmptyModels.zh: 服务返回的列表没有可用模型。可手动填写或重新获取。

DefaultModel.en: Save as the default model for future launches?
DefaultModel.zh: 设为以后启动时的默认模型？

CredentialLocal.zh: 密钥：保存在本机（不显示内容）

ToggleDefault.zh: 切换是否作为默认模型

EditProvider.zh: 修改提供方或接口格式

CapabilitiesTitle.en: Model capabilities (metadata, not a live compatibility test):
CapabilitiesTitle.zh: 模型能力（来自资料，尚未通过真实请求验证）：

LimitsMissing.en: Fill in positive context/output limits; output must leave room for input. No guessed limits will be saved.
LimitsMissing.zh: 请补充正整数的上下文和输出上限，输出必须给输入留出空间。不会保存猜测的容量。

EditLimits.zh: 修改上下文和输出上限

SourceConflict.zh: 服务资料（与内置档案不同）

SourceInputCeiling.en: service input ceiling {0}, used as a conservative total budget; confirm or edit
SourceInputCeiling.zh: 服务报告输入上限 {0}，暂作保守的总预算，请确认或修改

SourceProtocol.en: protocol defaults; editable for this service
SourceProtocol.zh: 接口默认值，可按服务修改

SourceUnknownEffort.en: unknown; no declared rungs (not a thinking-mode switch)
SourceUnknownEffort.zh: 未知；未声明档位（不代表关闭思考）

SourceHosted.en: not enabled; confirm endpoint support before enabling
SourceHosted.zh: 未启用；启用前请确认服务支持

TokenHelp.en: 1M = 1000k = 1000000; exact integers also accepted | Esc: back
TokenHelp.zh: 1M = 1000k = 1000000，也可填写精确整数 | Esc 返回

SwitchHelp.en: Select capabilities supported by BOTH model and endpoint. Unchecked means not enabled, not necessarily unsupported.
SwitchHelp.zh: 勾选模型和服务均支持的能力。未勾选表示不启用，并不表示模型一定不支持。

HostedUnavailable.en: Hosted search and image generation require the Responses adapter.
HostedUnavailable.zh: 服务端搜索和图片生成需要 Responses 接口。

ImageInputChoice.en: Image input (send images to the model)
ImageInputChoice.zh: 图片输入（向模型发送图片）

ImageGenerationChoice.zh: 服务端图片生成（生成图片）

EffortCustomNotice.en: Provider-specific rungs retain their declared order. Advanced settings can change their names and ordering.
EffortCustomNotice.zh: 自定义档位保留已声明的顺序，可在高级设置中修改名称和顺序。

EffortHelp.en: Select supported rungs, not the strength to use now. 'none' is the provider's no-thinking option; empty means unspecified, not thinking off.
EffortHelp.zh: 勾选模型支持的档位，不改变当前使用的强度。none 表示服务支持关闭思考；全不选表示未声明档位，不是关闭思考。

EffortMenu.en: Supported thinking effort rungs (Space to toggle)
EffortMenu.zh: 支持的思考档位（空格勾选）

CustomEffort.zh: 修改自定义档位名称和顺序

EffortInput.en: Provider effort names, weakest first, comma-separated (empty = unspecified)
EffortInput.zh: 提供方档位名称，由弱到强，用英文逗号分隔（留空表示未声明）

UsageInput.zh: {0} 的用量字段（用点分隔路径）

NotSaved.en: Not saved. Correct the problem and try again. Original diagnostic: {0}
NotSaved.zh: 尚未保存。请纠正问题后重试。原始诊断：{0}

Saved.en: Model configuration saved / selected. Exiting now will not delete it.
Saved.zh: 模型配置已保存或选定，此时退出不会删除它。

ChangedAfterSave.en: The model changed after selection; review it again.
ChangedAfterSave.zh: 选定后模型配置又发生了变化，请重新检查。

MissingKey.en: The selected credential is no longer available; please repair it.
MissingKey.zh: 选定的密钥已不可用，请修复。

DefaultNotSaved.en: Model saved; default selection NOT saved. Original diagnostic: {0}
DefaultNotSaved.zh: 模型已保存，但默认模型偏好未保存。原始诊断：{0}

RecoveryMenu.en: How would you like to continue?

RetryDefault.zh: 重试保存默认模型偏好

TestNotice.en: A connection test sends a short request and may incur a charge. It does not verify tools or a full conversation.
TestNotice.zh: 连接测试会发送简短的生成请求，可能产生费用；它不验证工具调用或完整对话。

TestSuccess.en: The provider returned a valid test response.
TestSuccess.zh: 服务返回了有效的测试响应。

TestFailure.en: Test did not succeed. Retry explicitly, change configuration, skip, or exit. Saved configuration was retained. Original diagnostic: {0}
TestFailure.zh: 测试未成功。可主动重试、修改配置、跳过或退出。已保存的配置仍保留。原始诊断：{0}
